code.change_task: add a new code family module (ToyFamilyCode: Z checks are full-rank random rows, X checks are the leading rows of the GF(2) nullspace basis of the Z checks, so hz@hx^T == 0 mod 2 by construction and k >= 1)
code.loc_detail: git diff --stat: 2 files changed, 45 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-) — src/quits/qldpc_code/toy_family.py (+43), src/quits/qldpc_code/__init__.py (+2/-1). The new family is immediately usable: ToyFamilyCode().build_circuit(strategy='zxcoloration') succeeds and verify_css_logicals() is True.

extraction.change_task: add a new syndrome-extraction strategy (ToyStrategyBuilder, name='toy': a pass-through that delegates to the zx-coloration builder, registered in the _BUILDERS registry)
extraction.loc_detail: git diff --stat: 2 files changed, 37 insertions(+) — src/quits/qldpc_code/circuit_construction/toy_strategy.py (+34), src/quits/qldpc_code/circuit_construction/__init__.py (+3: import, _BUILDERS entry, __all__ entry). The new strategy is immediately usable: code.build_circuit(strategy='toy') resolves through get_builder and returns a circuit.

architecture.change_task: add a new qubit topology/layout constraint (ToyGridLayout: a rectangular integer-grid Layout whose mapping() covers every data/zcheck/xcheck qubit index of any CSS code)
architecture.loc_detail: git diff --stat: 2 files changed, 57 insertions(+) — src/quits/layout/toy_grid.py (+55), src/quits/layout/__init__.py (+2). The new layout satisfies the Layout ABC: issubclass(ToyGridLayout, Layout) is True and mapping() returns a LayoutMapping covering all qubit indices.

executed_change_tasks.method: each dimension's standard change task (protocol.md §变更任务定义) was actually implemented on the pinned tree and measured with `git add -N <new files>; git diff --stat`. Per-dimension attribution is by file set: Code = toy_family.py + qldpc_code/__init__.py, Extraction = toy_strategy.py + circuit_construction/__init__.py, Architecture = toy_grid.py + layout/__init__.py. The three later tasks were implemented in one working tree, so the totals partition the same diff (46 + 37 + 57 = 140 lines = 139 insertions + 1 deletion).
executed_change_tasks.note: The static estimates (`touched_packages_est`) over-predicted for code/extraction/decoder (they included the `circuit`/`simulation` packages); the measured surface is one package per dimension for all five. All three later tasks were verified to be *usable*, not merely to compile: ToyFamilyCode().build_circuit('zxcoloration') builds a circuit and passes verify_css_logicals(); get_builder('toy', code) resolves through the registry; ToyGridLayout(code).mapping() returns a LayoutMapping covering every qubit index.
